pages.title: SWAT Ops: Bodycamera
pages.creator: eyeda.games
pages.description: Fight from a body-camera view in SWAT Ops: Bodycamera. Play three-minute deathmatches or four-versus-four team battles against bots across four maps. Earn coins for new equipment while working with the distorted, shaking viewpoint of the operator's camera.

pages.title: Sprinkle Roll
pages.creator: LMB Studio
pages.description: Steer a candy ball down elevated tracks in Sprinkle Roll. Avoid sweepers, gates and peppermint barriers while the road tilts and accelerates. Use rainbow ramps for a Sugar Rush boost and time jumps between moving platforms.

pages.title: Super Slime: Black Hole
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Swallow objects smaller than yourself in Super Slime: Black Hole. Move the slime around the scene and use what it eats to grow enough for larger targets. Keep expanding the range of objects it can absorb.

pages.title: Tanks
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Defend headquarters in Tanks. Drive through maze-like stages and destroy enemy armor before it reaches your base. Use cover and firing angles to survive each new group of attackers.

pages.title: Revoxel 3D - Voxel RPG Shooter
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Fight through a corporation-controlled city in Revoxel 3D - Voxel RPG Shooter. Use firearms against robots and monsters while developing the character's abilities. Explore the futuristic voxel setting as the combat grows more demanding.

pages.title: Molang Match'n Munch
pages.creator: Impulse Media Hub
pages.description: Recover endangered recipes in Molang Match'n Munch. Travel with Molang and Piu Piu through real and imaginary cities, making groups of three to collect ingredients. Complete the puzzles to help restore the Great Book of Flavors.

pages.title: Daily Match
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Connect identical pictures against the clock in Daily Match. Look for pairs that have an unobstructed route between them and remove them to open the board. Clear every tile before the timer ends to advance.

pages.title: Lingo Dreams
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Build vocabulary through paired translations in Lingo Dreams. Match an English word with its equivalent in your selected language, then continue with the words still on the board. Complete each set to practice another group.

pages.title: Sorting Xmas Balls
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Sort festive ornaments by color in Sorting Xmas Balls. Move the top pieces between tubes and use spare space to separate mixed stacks. Bring each color together as more containers and shades appear in later puzzles.

pages.title: Neon Blast
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Merge defensive cannons into stronger versions in Neon Blast. Position the upgraded weapons to handle attackers and bosses as the space battle continues. Keep combining the available pieces to unlock more powerful defenses.

pages.title: Boost Your Brain!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Tap a magical book to collect Aiku in Boost Your Brain! Sell the accumulated resource for earnings, improve skills and gather pets that add bonuses. Work toward more levels and skins as the clicker progression develops.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Find the Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Compare paired meme pictures in Italian Brainrot Find the Differences. Spot the altered details within a minute and avoid repeated wrong selections. Three mistakes end the attempt, so check a suspected change before clicking.

pages.title: Farmer Rush: Idle Farm Game
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Develop fields through merging in Farmer Rush: Idle Farm Game. Plant crops, combine matching ones and harvest what they produce. Improve the farm with the rewards to build up its output and open more progress.

pages.title: Going Balls Adventure 2
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide a ball through elevated courses in Going Balls Adventure 2. Gather the black balls required for the route and reach each checkpoint. Collect optional coins where the path is safe, and try available skins before a level begins.

pages.title: Fishing Fishes
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Build up a fishing operation in Fishing Fishes. Begin with basic equipment, collect catches and spend them on more fishers or useful upgrades. Increase production so the crew can bring in even more fish.

pages.title: Pets vs Bees
pages.creator: Visual Dream Games
pages.description: Draw protection around small heroes in Pets vs Bees. Finish a barrier before the bees leave their hive and look for gaps they could get through. Keep the dogs inside the shield until the attack has passed.

pages.title: Dad Escape
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Guide a baby through a maze in Dad Escape. Stay away from the searching parent and use objects or traps to slow him down. Work through each route before Dad can catch the little one.

pages.title: Dodgeball
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play aquatic contests in Dodgeball. Try a standard match, career progression or water wrestling against another character. In wrestling mode, land hits quickly enough to move the opponent back and win the exchange.

pages.title: Butcher Warehouse
pages.creator: Simplicity Games
pages.description: Run a small food market in Butcher Warehouse. Move around the farm and machines to collect products, then bring them to customers for sale. Use the earnings to improve equipment and grow the operation.

pages.title: Mine Cart Noob
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Launch Steve toward home in Mine Cart Noob. Send the trolley over obstacles, gather coins and use upgrades to improve its next journey. Unlock tricks and try to carry the little vehicle farther through the physics course.

pages.title: Protect My Dog 2
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Keep swarming insects away in Protect My Dog 2. Draw one line to form a barrier that blocks the bees while leaving the dog safely inside. Work through eighty-five layouts with increasingly awkward places to build the shield.

pages.title: Model Dress Up Girl Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Create outfits for virtual models in Model Dress Up Girl Games. Browse clothes and accessories, then compare different combinations on the dolls. Save a screenshot when you have a finished look to show friends.

pages.title: Celebrity Chinese New Year Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare stars for a seasonal celebration in Celebrity Chinese New Year Look. Pick festive clothes and coordinated makeup for each character. Try the statement pieces before finishing the outfits for the holiday.

pages.title: Mosquito Run 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Lead a swarm toward its target in Mosquito Run 3D. Add insects to the group while steering around hazards along the course. Reach the person at the end with more mosquitoes to earn a stronger score.

pages.title: Word Stack
pages.creator: Trumdu Projects
pages.description: Join letter cubes to reveal hidden answers in Word Stack. Swipe through words on the board and use hints when a combination is difficult to see. Find extra words and return on another day for additional rewards.

pages.title: Cat Safari 2
pages.creator: upjers
pages.description: Open boxes and merge their kittens in Cat Safari 2. Combine two cats of the same type to discover another breed, then repeat with the new arrivals. Keep developing the collection across the abandoned field.

pages.title: Which Sea Creature Looks Different
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare three underwater pictures in Which Sea Creature Looks Different. Two images match exactly, so select the altered creature in the set. Work through thirty groups by examining small details in the animals' shapes and markings.

pages.title: Pipol Smasher
pages.creator: Bubblebox
pages.description: Use cars and scenery to clear targets in Pipol Smasher. Start or stop vehicles at the right moments and work out how nearby obstacles affect them. Solve each cartoon physics puzzle by reaching everyone on the route.

pages.title: Yummy Taco
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Prepare a meal from scratch in Yummy Taco. Make dough and tortillas, cook the beef and add vegetables or sauce for the filling. Serve the completed tacos to the customers waiting for them.

pages.title: Supercars Zombie Driving 2
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Drive through an infected city in Supercars Zombie Driving 2. Find the undead scattered around the map and run them down to clear the level. Use the brake or change the camera when you need to line up the next approach.

pages.title: Festival Dia de Muertos
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create festive looks in Festival Dia de Muertos. Dress the characters for the Day of the Dead celebration and coordinate makeup with their outfits. Explore the available clothes and decorations before finishing each style.

pages.title: Combat 3d Pixel Strike Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Fight other players in Combat 3d Pixel Strike Multiplayer. Move through the map, choose firing positions and keep track of rivals approaching from different directions. Use your equipment to score eliminations while staying in the match.

pages.title: CPL Tournament 2020
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Time cricket strokes in CPL Tournament 2020. Practice in single-match mode before entering the larger competition, watching each delivery to judge the swing. Build enough runs to carry your team through the tournament.

pages.title: Trash Sorting for Kids
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Place litter in the correct containers in Trash Sorting for Kids. Drag plastic to its recycling bin and food scraps to organic waste. Sort every object according to its material to complete the activity.

pages.title: JoJo Seewa Dream
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style a young performer in JoJo Seewa Dream. Choose clothing and accessories for the character, then coordinate the pieces into a finished look. Try different combinations to create an outfit suited to her energetic style.

pages.title: Merge Dungeon
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Improve a party's equipment in Merge Dungeon. Combine matching gear into stronger items as the soldiers fight approaching monsters. Keep upgrading their weapons and armor before a tougher boss joins the battle.

pages.title: Pixelkenstein 80s Time
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Collect diamonds and operate oil levers in Pixelkenstein 80s Time. Move through retro-styled platforms while searching for the objects needed to finish each stage. Gather more diamonds to improve the final score.

pages.title: Santa Run
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Deliver gifts while running through town in Santa Run. Use the arrow keys or on-screen controls to get past obstacles and keep moving down the streets. Extend the endless route to build a higher score.

pages.title: Shooting Color
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fire colored shots to reproduce a picture in Shooting Color. Choose which cannon should act first, since later hits can cover colors already on the blocks. Complete the correct layer order to match the example.

pages.title: City Race Destruction
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Explore a city and enter survival events in City Race Destruction. Look for special signs that start races along narrow streets, then collect coins and prize money. Buy faster or more heavily armored vehicles for the next contest.

pages.title: Pizza Maker My Pizzeria
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take phone orders in Pizza Maker My Pizzeria. Follow the requested recipe to prepare each pizza and send it out before the delivery is late. Check the customer review to see how the completed order was received.

pages.title: Drifty Race
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Time automatic drifts in Drifty Race. Tap when the moving car reaches a corner so it follows the track instead of running wide. Watch the next curve early enough to keep pace with the other racers.

pages.title: 911 Rescue Helicopter Simulation 2020
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: Fly military or civilian aircraft on rescue assignments in 911 Rescue Helicopter Simulation 2020. Travel across New York during different weather and lighting conditions. Complete each mission while keeping the helicopter controlled through the city.

pages.title: Go Fishing
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Tap to drop a hook in Go Fishing. Line it up with a passing fish and bring the catch back without letting a larger fish eat it. Watch the water before choosing the next cast.

pages.title: Cross That Road
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Guide small animals across traffic and water in Cross That Road. Time movements around cars and trains, then use safe crossings over rivers. See how many roads and other hazards you can pass before the run ends.

pages.title: Dump Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Flip tiles to reveal matching vehicles in Dump Trucks Memory. Remember where each truck picture is hidden and uncover its pair before the countdown expires. Clear all the cards to finish the current board.

pages.title: Penguin Avoids
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Bounce a bird toward golden stars in Penguin Avoids. Tap to change its movement and stay clear of dangerous objects and sharp boundaries. Pick a route that reaches the stars without putting the penguin into a hazard.

pages.title: BTS Robot Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint mechanical characters in BTS Robot Coloring Book. Choose an outlined picture and fill the robot's panels and other details with your own colors. Try another palette for a different design when the current image is complete.

pages.title: Drive Hills
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Carry a fragile passenger through hilly routes in Drive Hills. Guide the vehicle around obstacles while keeping its egg secure. Collect coins to unlock other cars and eggs as you travel toward the next city.

pages.title: Easter Card Memory Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Find pairs of seasonal pictures in Easter Card Memory Deluxe. Turn over a card, remember its position and select the matching item when you find it. Clear each board within the time limit as later levels become harder.

pages.title: ZombiesOnTheTimes
pages.creator: Juan Rivera
pages.description: Fight through waves of undead in ZombiesOnTheTimes. Move with WASD and use the mouse to fire at threats around you. Keep the character alive in the retro-styled setting for as long as possible.

pages.title: Container Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rebuild twelve freight-vehicle images in Container Trucks Jigsaw. Select an available picture and difficulty, then drag the pieces into the right places. Finish scenes to unlock more views of the trucks.

pages.title: Aqua Man Sea Fight
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Swim to mission destinations in Aqua Man Sea Fight. Collect the items listed for the current task while watching for fish that hunt the character. Use WASD and the swimming control to move away from the next threat.

pages.title: Tricky Turns
pages.creator: Igor Milienko
pages.description: Reverse the direction of rotation in Tricky Turns. Avoid black squares while catching white ones for a point each. Time a click or tap before the next collision and work toward a longer collection streak.

pages.title: Ambulance Mission 3D
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Transport patients quickly in Ambulance Mission 3D. Reach people around the city, pick them up and drive to the hospital before their condition timer expires. Follow each rescue destination while managing traffic along the route.

pages.title: Survival shooting war game pixel gun apocalypse 3
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight pixel-style enemies in Survival shooting war game pixel gun apocalypse 3. Try weapons such as a chainsaw or minigun and choose online or offline battles. Enter survival waves or gun-game contests as you test the arsenal.

pages.title: Kids Memory Sea Creatures
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Learn animal names while finding pairs in Kids Memory Sea Creatures. Reveal pictures, remember where they are and match identical sea animals. Select easy, medium or hard mode to change the size of the memory challenge.

pages.title: Monster Dragon City Destroyer
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Attack a city as a flying creature in Monster Dragon City Destroyer. Guide the dragon with WASD or the arrow keys and use its powers against the surroundings. Work through the urban destruction missions as more targets appear.

pages.title: Head Soccer World Champion
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Play oversized football duels in Head Soccer World Champion. Move with A and D and use W to jump into the ball's path. Send it toward the opponent's goal while staying ready to defend your own.

pages.title: Super Brick Ball
pages.creator: FreeGames.org
pages.description: Fire a line of bouncing shots in Super Brick Ball. Move the aim with the mouse or finger, then release to send the balls through the blocks. Choose a path that strikes several targets before the shots return.

pages.title: Bonnie And Friends Kith Fashion
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Explore streetwear with a group of friends in Bonnie And Friends Kith Fashion. Browse the clothing and compare how the pieces fit each character. Create a separate casual outfit for everyone before completing their looks.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Thanksgiving Fun
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Visit relatives for a seasonal meal in Baby Hazel Thanksgiving Fun. Dress Hazel in festive clothes and help the family finish preparations at the grandparents' home. Join the activities as the group gets ready to celebrate.

pages.title: The Last Warrior
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Defend your land from incoming soldiers in The Last Warrior. Aim at the attackers and keep firing as they approach your position. Clear each group while trying to remain the final defender standing.

pages.title: Basketball Shooting Stars
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Practice shots on goal in Basketball Shooting Stars. Use the mouse to line up an attempt and watch the ball's arc toward the hoop. Adjust for the next shot as you work on more accurate baskets.

pages.title: Pac Game
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Clear a maze in Pac Game by gathering every dot. Stay away from pursuing monsters until a magic potion makes them vulnerable. Use that brief advantage to reach dangerous sections and finish the remaining food.

pages.title: Fortress Defense
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Stop invaders from reaching a stronghold in Fortress Defense. Use the available attacks and spend progress on upgrades or boosts. Prepare for the next level as the enemy force becomes harder to hold back.

pages.title: Toyota Prius Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six car images in Toyota Prius Puzzle 2. Choose a layout of sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four or one hundred pieces and reconstruct the vehicle. Use its details and background colors to identify the correct joins.

pages.title: Puzzles
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fit colorful silhouettes into their matching spaces in Puzzles. Choose an animal, vehicle or geometric piece and drag it to the outline that fits. Complete both sides of the board to finish the shape-matching activity.

pages.title: Sliding Santa Clause
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a festive character down snowy paths in Sliding Santa Clause. Change direction before reaching obstacles and keep the slide within the safe route. See how far Santa can travel before a missed turn ends the attempt.

pages.title: Jurassic Dino Hunting
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Track prehistoric targets in Jurassic Dino Hunting. Move into position, use the mouse to aim and fire when the dinosaur is in sight. Complete the hunting objectives across the levels while watching the surrounding ground.

pages.title: ClickThePlay
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Find the missing button in ClickThePlay. Inspect the scene and click or drag objects to uncover the symbol. Work out a different interaction in each puzzle so you can start the next one.

pages.title: Smart Soccer
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Take a nation into short matches in Smart Soccer. Drag to set a player's direction and strength, then release to strike the ball. Be the first to score three goals against the computer to win.

pages.title: Flippy Weapons
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Use shots to lift a rotating gun in Flippy Weapons. Wait until its angle can carry it upward before clicking to fire. Keep the weapon climbing and try to improve the score before its movement breaks the run.

pages.title: Tasty Food Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reconstruct meal pictures in Tasty Food Jigsaw Puzzle. Pick an image and choose easy, medium or hard difficulty before joining the scattered pieces. Work through the details at your own pace without a countdown.

pages.title: Goldie Princess Mommy Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help a princess through the arrival of her baby in Goldie Princess Mommy Birth. Call an ambulance, monitor her needs while waiting and keep her supplied with water or breathing support. Continue the story with a hospital visit afterward.

pages.title: Blocky Sharpshooter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Clear hostile targets in Blocky Sharpshooter. Find each enemy in the view and fire before they can take down your character. Keep the aim accurate as another target enters the shooting challenge.

pages.title: Fireboy and Watergirl 1 Forest Temple
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide two characters through the Forest Temple in Fireboy and Watergirl 1 Forest Temple. Collect diamonds and use each character where its element is safe. Solve the switches and platforms together while keeping Fireboy out of water and Watergirl away from fire.

pages.title: Lord Of The Knights
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Defend a castle with a crossbow in Lord Of The Knights. Shoot the approaching skeleton army and use the lord's equipment to hold the position. Keep the attackers from reaching the city as the siege continues.

pages.title: Easter Pop
pages.creator: Duchnowski
pages.description: Tap matching groups in Easter Pop to clear three or more eggs of one color. Pick up bonuses that help remove more pieces and keep finding another cluster. Build the best score you can before time runs out.

pages.title: Gummy Blocks
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Place soft-colored shapes into a grid in Gummy Blocks. Complete rows or columns to clear space for the next pieces. Plan around the gaps each shape leaves so the board does not fill.

pages.title: Barbie The Voice
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help a singer prepare for an audition in Barbie The Voice. Put together the appearance she will take on stage and follow her attempt to move beyond cover performances. Finish the look before her chance to impress the judges.

pages.title: Paws to Beauty: Baby Beast
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Care for young wild animals in Paws to Beauty: Baby Beast. Choose a pet, wash its coat and use the grooming tools to finish the care session. Pick decorative details to give the cleaned animal its own look.

pages.title: Wild Race 3D
pages.creator: Chilican
pages.description: Drive a car for distance and points in Wild Race 3D. Keep it under control as you follow the road and work toward a better run. Unlock additional vehicles and compare scores with friends on the leaderboard.
